facts.statement: Avimimus was officially described by Dr. Sergei Kurzanov in 1981 after being recovered by Russian paleontologists.
facts.quote: The remains of Avimimus were recovered by Russian paleontologists and officially described by Dr. Sergei Kurzanov in 1981.

facts.statement: A new species, Avimimus nemegtensis, was formally described in 2018 based on previously identified material.
facts.quote: In 2018, Avimimus sp. was formally described as a new species, A. nemegtensis.

facts.statement: Avimimus was a small, bird-like dinosaur measuring approximately 1.5 meters (5 feet) in length.
facts.quote: Avimimus was a small, bird-like dinosaur with a length of 1.5 m (5 ft).

facts.statement: Avimimus had a small skull relative to its body, but possessed a large brain and eyes.
facts.quote: The skull was small compared to the body, though the brain and eyes were large.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Avimimus preserved no teeth, though tooth-like projections were found at the tip of the premaxilla.
facts.quote: The jaws of Avimimus were thought to form a parrot-like beak lacking teeth, and a thorough review of the holotype specimen's anatomy confirmed that no teeth were preserved, although a series of tooth-like projections along the tip of the premaxilla were.

facts.statement: Quill knobs were reported on Avimimus in 1987, and while bumps on the ulna were confirmed, their specific function remains unclear.
facts.quote: Kurzanov, in 1987, also reported the presence of quill knobs, and while Chiappe confirmed the presence of bumps on the ulna, their function remained unclear.

facts.statement: Avimimus had an almost horizontally oriented ilium that resulted in exceptionally broad hips.
facts.quote: The ilium was almost horizontally oriented, resulting in exceptionally broad hips.

facts.statement: Avimimus possessed extremely long and slender legs, suggesting it was a highly specialized runner.
facts.quote: The legs were extremely long and slender, suggesting that Avimimus was a highly specialized runner.

facts.statement: Avimimus had three-toed feet equipped with narrow, pointed claws.
facts.quote: It also had three-toed feet with narrow pointed claws.

facts.statement: Recent studies group Avimimus within the family Oviraptoridae and the subgroup Elmisaurinae.
facts.quote: More recent studies have shown that Avimimus is best grouped within the Oviraptoridae, within the subgroup Elmisaurinae.

facts.statement: Avimimus lived approximately 70 million years ago during the Campanian stage of the late Cretaceous in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período el Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 70 millones de años, en el Campaniense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: The first Avimimus specimen was discovered in the Djadokhta Formation and officially described by Dr. Sergei Kurzanov in 1981.
facts.quote: El primer espécimen fue descubierto en la Formación de Djadochta y fue descrito oficialmente por el Doctor Sergi Kurzanov en 1981.

facts.statement: The preservation of Avimimus bonebeds suggests they were buried rapidly, uncovered by water flow, and then buried again nearby.
facts.quote: The preservation of the bonebeds suggest that they were buried rapidly, uncovered by rapid flow of water, and then buried again a short distance away.

facts.statement: Avimimus coexisted with dinosaurs such as the tyrannosaurid Tarbosaurus and the hadrosaurid Saurolophus in the Nemegt Formation.
facts.quote: In the Nemegt it coexisted with other dinosaurs like, the tyrannosaurid Tarbosaurus, hadrosaurid Saurolophus, and a variety of other dinosaurs.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Avimimus originated from the Djadokhta Formation as originally thought, with evidence suggesting it likely hailed from the more recent Nemegt Formation.
facts.quote: Watabe and colleagues noted that Kurzanov was probably mistaken about the provenance, and it is more likely that Avimimus hailed from the more recent Nemegt Formation.

facts.statement: While some evidence suggests Avimimus was an herbivore or omnivore, Kurzanov originally believed it was an insectivore.
facts.quote: Kurzanov himself, however, believed that Avimimus was an insectivore.

facts.statement: Avimimus was a small dinosaur standing 45 centimeters tall at the hip and measuring about 1.6 meters in length.
facts.quote: Avimimus era un dinosaurio pequeño, de 45 centímetros de altura hasta la cadera y un largo de alrededor de 1,6 metros.

facts.statement: Avimimus had a small skull relative to its body but possessed a large brain and enormous eye sockets.
facts.quote: Su cráneo, pequeño en comparación con el cuerpo, pero tenía un gran cerebro y unas cuencas oculares desmesuradas.

facts.statement: Instead of teeth, Avimimus possessed a horny beak very similar to that of parrots.
facts.quote: En el lugar de los dientes, presentaba un pico córneo, muy semejante al de los loros.

facts.statement: Unlike other similar dinosaurs, Avimimus may have had a serrated edge on its beak due to tooth-like projections on the premaxilla.
facts.quote: A diferencia de estos, una serie de proyecciones similares a dientes en el borde premaxilar pudo haberle dado un borde aserrado.

facts.statement: Avimimus' toothless beak suggests it was likely a herbivore or omnivore.
facts.quote: El pico desdentado de Avimimus sugiere que debe habes sido herbívoro o omnívoro.

facts.statement: Kurzanov hypothesized that Avimimus may have been an insectivore.
facts.quote: Kurzanov por su lado, cree que Avimimus habría sido insectívoro.

facts.statement: Avimimus had a long, thin neck composed of vertebrae much longer than those of other oviraptorosaurs.
facts.quote: El cuello en sí mismo era largo y delgado, y se compone de vértebras mucho más alargadas que en otros oviraptorosaurianos.

facts.statement: Unlike oviraptorids and caenagnathids, Avimimus lacked openings in the rear of its vertebrae for air sacs, suggesting it was more primitive than these groups.
facts.quote: A diferencia que los oviraptóridos y cenagnátidos, carencia de las aberturas en la de la parte posterior de las vértebras para sacos aéreos, sugiriendo que Avimimus es más primitivo que estos animales.

facts.statement: Avimimus had relatively short arms with fused hand bones like modern birds, and Kurzanov interpreted a ridge on the ulna as an attachment point for feathers.
facts.quote: Los brazos son relativamente cortos. Los huesos de la mano se fusionan juntos, como en las aves modernas, y un canto en el cúbito (hueso de un brazo más bajo) fue interpretado como punto de accesorio para las plumas por Kurzanov.

facts.statement: Kurzanov concluded that Avimimus might have been capable of weak flight based on his interpretation of feather attachment points.
facts.quote: Kurzanov, convencido de que eran puntos de accesorio para las plumas que concluyó que Avimimus puede haber sido capaz de un vuelo débil.

facts.statement: While the presence of feathers is widely accepted, most paleontologists do not believe Avimimus could fly.
facts.quote: La presencia de plumas ahora se acepta extensamente, pero la mayoría de los paleontólogos no creen que Avimimus pudiera volar.

facts.statement: Avimimus had extremely long and thin legs, suggesting it was a highly specialized runner.
facts.quote: Con piernas extremadamente largas y delgadas, sugieren que Avimimus era un corredor sumamente especializado.

facts.statement: Avimimus walked on three toes equipped with narrow claws.
facts.quote: Habría pisado sobre tres dedos con unas garras estrechas.

facts.statement: Avimimus remains were recovered by Russian paleontologists and officially described by Dr. Sergei Kurzanov in 1981.
facts.quote: Los restos de Avimimus fueron recuperados por los paleontólogos rusos y descritos oficialmente por el Dr. Sergei Kurzanov en 1981.

facts.statement: Kurzanov initially described Avimimus fossils as coming from the Djadokhta Formation.
facts.quote: Los fósiles de Avimimus fueron descritos inicialmente como provenientes de la Formación Djadokta por Kurzanov.

facts.statement: In 2006, Watabe and colleagues suggested that Avimimus likely originated from the Nemegt Formation rather than the Djadokhta Formation.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, en la descripción de una nueva muestra de 2006, Watabe y colegas observaron que Kurzanov probablemente se equivocó acerca de la procedencia, y es más probable de que Avimimus provenga de la más reciente Formación Nemegt.

facts.statement: Various isolated bones attributed to Avimimus but differing from A. portentosus are referred to as Avimimus sp., potentially representing one or more distinct species.
facts.quote: Una variedad de huesos aislados que se han atribuido a Avimimus pero difieren de A. portentosus y puede representar una o más especies distintas, referidas como Avimimus sp.

facts.statement: In 2008, a team led by Philip J. Currie announced the discovery of an extensive bone bed of Avimimus sp.
facts.quote: En 2008, un equipo de Canadá, Estados Unidos, y paleontólogos mongoles encabezada por Philip J. Currie anunció el descubrimiento de una extensa cama de huesos de Avimimus sp.

facts.statement: The team reported finding abundant bones of at least ten Avimimus individuals, though the deposit may contain more.
facts.quote: El equipo informó del hallazgo de abundantes huesos de al menos diez individuos de Avimimus, pero el depósito puede contener más.

facts.statement: In 2018, these Avimimus sp. remains were formally described as a new species, A. nemegtensis.
facts.quote: En 2018, estos restos de Avimimus sp. fueron descritos formalmente como una nueva especie, A. nemegtensis.

facts.statement: Avimimus lived in the Barun Goyot Formation of Mongolia during the Campanian stage, between 84 and 70 million years ago in the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: La Formación Barun Goyot de Mongolia, se estima que se remonta a la etapa Campaniense, hace entre 84 y 70 millones de años del cretáceo tardío.

facts.statement: During the Cretaceous, the area now known as the Barun Goyot Formation had an arid environment with sand dune fields and only intermittent water currents.
facts.quote: Durante el período cretáceo, lo que ahora es la Formación Barun Goyot tenían un ambiente árido con campos dedunas de arena y solo intermitentes corrientes de agua.

facts.statement: Avimimus was originally considered a very close relative of birds due to a unique set of avian characteristics unknown in other dinosaurs at the time.
facts.quote: A Avimimus se lo consideró originalmente como un pariente muy cercano de las aves, dado su especial conjunto de características de aves no conocidas en otros dinosaurios en el momento.

facts.statement: However, this view has not been supported by later phylogenetic analyses of dinosaur and bird relationships.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, este punto de vista no ha sido apoyado por posteriores análisis filogenéticos de las relaciones de dinosaurios y aves.

facts.statement: Most modern scientists classify Avimimus within the diverse group of primitive bird-like dinosaurs known as oviraptorosaurs, rather than as a direct bird ancestor.
facts.quote: La mayoría de los científicos modernos encuentran que Avimimus, de hecho, pertenece a un grupo diverso de dinosaurios similares a las aves más primitivos que el Archaeopteryx, los oviraptorosaurios.

facts.statement: Kurzanov placed Avimimus in its own family, Avimimidae, in 1981.
facts.quote: Kurzanov coloco a Avimimus en su propia familia, Avimimidae, en 1981.

facts.statement: Recent studies show that Avimimus groups best within Oviraptoridae, specifically in the subfamily Elmisaurinae.
facts.quote: Estudios más recientes han demostrado que Avimimus se agrupa mejor dentro de Oviraptoridae, dentro del subgrupo Elmisaurinae.

facts.statement: Watabe and colleagues identified a series of small theropod footprints in the same area that likely belonged to Avimimus.
facts.quote: Además, estos autores identificaron una serie de pequeñas huellas de terópodos en la misma zona que pertenecerian a Avimimus.

facts.statement: The preservation of the bone beds suggests the animals were buried quickly by a rapid water flow and then reburied a short distance away.
facts.quote: La preservación de los lechos de huesos sugieren que fueron enterrados rápidamente, descubiertos por un flujo rápido de agua, y luego enterrados de nuevo a una corta distancia.

facts.statement: Avimimus had large bones surrounding the cranial cavity dedicated to protecting the brain, consistent with its having a large brain.
facts.quote: El tamaño de los huesos que rodean la cavidad craneana y estarían dedicados a proteger el encéfalo eran grandes. Esto es consistente con el hecho de que Avimimus haya tenido un gran cerebro.

facts.statement: Avimimus had an ilium oriented almost horizontally, resulting in exceptionally wide hips.
facts.quote: El ilion estaba orientado casi horizontalmente, dando por resultado caderas excepcionalmente amplias.

facts.statement: Avimimus had long tibiae relative to its femurs, a trait common in running animals.
facts.quote: Las espinillas eran largas en comparación con sus muslos, rasgo común con los animales corredores.

facts.statement: While Kurzanov reported a keel and Chiappe confirmed bumps on the ulna, the function of these structures remained unclear.
facts.quote: Kurzanov, en 1987, también divulgó la presencia de una quilla, y mientras que Chiappe confirmó la presencia de topetones en el cúbito, su función seguía siendo confusa.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Avimimus could fly; Kurzanov concluded it might have been capable of weak flight, but most paleontologists today do not believe it could fly despite the accepted presence of feathers.
facts.quote: Kurzanov, convencido de que eran puntos de accesorio para las plumas que concluyó que Avimimus puede haber sido capaz de un vuelo débil. La presencia de plumas ahora se acepta extensamente, pero la mayoría de los paleontólogos no creen que Avimimus pudiera volar.

facts.statement: There is a debate regarding Avimimus' diet; while the toothless beak suggests herbivory or omnivory, Kurzanov hypothesized it was an insectivore.
facts.quote: El pico desdentado de Avimimus sugiere que debe habes sido herbívoro o omnívoro. Kurzanov por su lado, cree que Avimimus habría sido insectívoro.

facts.statement: Avimimus belongs to the parent group Oviraptorosauria.
facts.quote: Parent group: Oviraptorosauria

facts.statement: The type species of Avimimus is Avimimus portentosus.
facts.quote: Type species: Avimimus portentosus

facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Maastrichtian (83.6 to 66 million years ago)
